events.title: A user requests an export
events.because: The API accepts the request and puts a job on the queue; the user sees "Queued".

events.title: A worker claims the job
events.because: A claim stops a second worker from taking the same job, so the export is built once.

events.title: The storage call times out
events.because: The call has no retry path, so the task ends as failed after 38 s.

events.title: The lease expires and nothing reads it
events.because: Only a recovery job reads expired leases, and it has not been scheduled, so the job stays "Running" for good.
